fields.name: IMO
fields.label: IMO number
fields.relevance: mandatory for MRV&DCS
fields.description: The unique 7-digit International Maritime Organization identification number assigned to the vessel. Mandatory for linking bunker records to the correct ship under MRV and DCS frameworks.

fields.name: BDN_Number
fields.label: Bunker Delivery Note Number
fields.relevance: mandatory for MRV&DCS
fields.description: The unique alphanumeric identifier for the Bunker Delivery Note. This references a specific bunker drop and must be used to track the exact batch consumption in operational logs.

fields.name: Used_By_BDN
fields.label: BDN number of the resulting fuel blend
fields.mandatoryNote: A value is required for fuel components.
fields.relevance: out of scope for GHG verification
fields.description: The resulting BDN number assigned to a new fuel blend created onboard. Used to trace the consumption of blended fuels back to their individual component bunker drops.

fields.name: Coming_From_BDN
fields.label: BDN number of parent fuel
fields.mandatoryNote: A value is required for fuel components, where the component is already defined as a bunker record.
fields.relevance: out of scope for GHG verification
fields.description: The original parent BDN number of a fuel component that is being used to create an onboard fuel blend.

fields.name: Bunker_Delivery_Date
fields.label: Bunker Delivery Date
fields.relevance: mandatory for MRV&DCS
fields.description: The Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) date marking the completion of the bunker delivery operations. Essential for chronologically ordering fuel batches.

fields.name: Bunker_Delivery_Time
fields.label: Bunker Delivery Time
fields.relevance: mandatory for MRV&DCS
fields.description: The Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) time marking the completion of the bunker transfer.

fields.name: Fuel_Type
fields.label: Fuel Type
fields.relevance: mandatory for MRV&DCS
fields.description: The standardized fuel classification code (e.g., HFO, LFO, MGO, BioLNG, eMethanol) representing the chemical and regulatory category of the delivered fuel.

fields.name: Mass
fields.label: Mass
fields.mandatoryNote: A value is required for all fuel types, except for the fuel type "BLEND" where it is optional to report the mass.
fields.relevance: mandatory for MRV&DCS
fields.description: The total delivered mass of the fuel in metric tons (mt). Critical for mass-balance tracking across voyage consumption and remaining onboard (ROB) calculations.

fields.name: EU_Lower_Calorific_Value
fields.label: Lower Calorific Value (EU)
fields.relevance: Mandatory for biofuels for FuelEU Maritime
fields.description: The Lower Calorific Value (LCV) of the fuel in MJ/kg, defined according to Annex III of Directive (EU) 2018/2001. Mandatory for calculating energy pools for biofuels under the FuelEU Maritime regulation.

fields.name: EU_GHG_Intensity
fields.label: EU GHG emission intensity
fields.relevance: Mandatory for biofuels and e-fuels for FuelEU Maritime
fields.description: The Well-to-Wake (WtW) greenhouse gas emission intensity 'E' expressed in gCO2eq/MJ. Mandatory reporting for biofuels and e-fuels under FuelEU Maritime, derived from the Proof of Sustainability.

fields.name: Sustainability
fields.label: Sustainability
fields.relevance: Mandatory for biofuels for MRV/DCS and FuelEU Maritime
fields.description: Reference string containing the Unique Number of the Proof of Sustainability (PoS) or the recognized certification scheme (e.g., ISCC, RSB). Mandatory for claiming zero or reduced emission factors for biofuels under MRV/DCS and FuelEU Maritime.

fields.name: Lower_Heating_Value
fields.label: Lower heating value
fields.relevance: Mandatory for biofuels for DCS
fields.description: The Lower Calorific Value (LCV) of the fuel in MJ/kg as defined by IMO guidelines. Used specifically for calculating energy and mass equivalents for IMO DCS and CII reporting.

fields.name: IMO_GHG_Intensity
fields.label: IMO GHG emission intensity
fields.relevance: Mandatory for biofuels under IMO DCS/CII scheme until LCA guidelines are applied in IMO reporting scheme
fields.description: The greenhouse gas intensity value for biofuels applied under MEPC.1/Circ.905 guidelines. Required for IMO DCS/CII reporting until formalized LCA guidelines are fully implemented.

fields.name: FLL_Energy_Share
fields.label: Energy share in fuel blend
fields.relevance: out of scope for GHG verification
fields.description: The percentage share of total energy contributed by a specific fuel component within an onboard blend, calculated based on the IMO Lower Calorific Value. Supports Fuel Lifecycle Label (FLL) tracking.

fields.name: IMO_Fuel_Pathway_Code
fields.label: Fuel pathway code
fields.relevance: out of scope for GHG verification
fields.description: The specific production pathway code as defined by IMO LCA guidelines. Serves as the unique identifier for evaluating the well-to-tank emissions footprint of alternative fuels.

fields.name: Density_At_15dg
fields.label: Density @ 15 °C
fields.relevance: out of scope for GHG verification
fields.description: The physical density of the delivered fuel measured in metric tons per cubic meter (mt/m3) at a standard reference temperature of 15 degrees Celsius.

fields.name: Sulphur_Content
fields.label: Sulphur Content
fields.relevance: out of scope for GHG verification
fields.description: The mass fraction percentage (% m/m) of sulphur present in the delivered fuel. Used to verify compliance with MARPOL Annex VI global sulphur caps and ECA zone limits.

fields.name: Viscosity
fields.label: Viscosity
fields.relevance: out of scope for GHG verification
fields.description: The kinematic viscosity of the fuel at a standard reference temperature, usually measured in centistokes (cSt), dictating necessary onboard heating and purification parameters.

fields.name: Water_Content
fields.label: Water content
fields.relevance: out of scope for GHG verification
fields.description: The percentage of water by volume (% V/V) present in the delivered bunker batch.

fields.name: Higher_Heating_Value
fields.label: Higher heating value
fields.relevance: out of scope for GHG verification
fields.description: The Higher Heating Value (HHV) or gross calorific value of the fuel in MJ/kg, capturing total heat released including the condensation of water vapor.

fields.name: Bunker_Port
fields.label: Bunker port
fields.relevance: out of scope for GHG verification
fields.description: The 5-letter UN/LOCODE identifying the geographical port or location where the bunker delivery took place.

fields.name: Grade
fields.label: Grade
fields.relevance: out of scope for GHG verification
fields.description: The commercial ISO 8217 specification grade of the fuel (e.g., RMG 380, DMA) defining its physical and chemical boundaries.

fields.name: TtW_CO2_CF
fields.label: Tank-to-Wake CO2 conversion factor
fields.relevance: out of scope for GHG verification
fields.description: The Tank-to-Wake CO2 conversion factor (gCO2/gFuel). Historically used for non-standard fuels; deprecated for post-2024 compliance reporting where standardized regulatory factors or DNV-approved pathways are mandated.
